mkdir -p /workspace/tools && cat > /workspace/tools/refmodel.py <<'PYEOF'
"""Independent reference model + image validator written from PROTOCOL.md.

This is a development helper (not part of the collected src tree).
"""
import json

HOP_NULL = 4194303
ABSENT = 15 << 6


def norm(addr_hex, length):
    v = int(addr_hex, 16)
    return (v >> (128 - length) << (128 - length)) if length else 0


def lpm(fib, addr_int):
    """fib: dict length -> (masked_value, hop); returns hop or None."""
    best = None
    best_len = -1
    for length, (val, hop) in fib.items():
        if length <= best_len:
            continue
        if (addr_int >> (128 - length)) == (val >> (128 - length)):
            best = hop
            best_len = length
    return best


def mask(v, length):
    if length <= 0:
        return 0
    return (v >> (128 - length)) << (128 - length) if length < 128 else v


class Fail(Exception):
    pass


def check(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        raise Fail(msg)


def bits_of(word_hex):
    """Return the 256 bit word as an int (bit0 = LSB)."""
    return int(word_hex, 16)


def field(word, off, n):
    return (word >> off) & ((1 << n) - 1)


class ImageValidator:
    def __init__(self, img):
        self.img = img
        self.nodes = []
        self.owner = {}
        self.fib = {}      # (len, value) -> hop
        self.prefixes = {} # (length, masked value) -> hop

    def run(self):
        img = self.img
        check(set(img) == {"root", "front16", "front64", "cells", "banks", "bitmaps", "nexthops"},
              "keys")
        check(len(img["cells"]) == 11 and len(img["banks"]) == 11, "cells/banks count")
        for s in range(11):
            check(0 <= img["cells"][s] <= 131072, "cells range")
            check(len(img["banks"][s]) == (img["cells"][s] + 1) // 2, "bank rows")
            check(len(img["banks"][s]) <= 65536, "bank bound")
        check(sum(len(b) for b in img["banks"]) <= 65536, "rows bound")
        check(len(img["bitmaps"]) <= 8193, "bitmap bound")
        check(len(img["nexthops"]) <= 8192, "ni bound")
        check(len(img["front16"]) <= 4096 and len(img["front64"]) <= 4096, "front bound")
        for name, width in (("front16", 4), ("front64", 16)):
            prev = None
            for e in img[name]:
                check(isinstance(e, list) and len(e) == 3, "front entry")
                check(len(e[0]) == width and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in e[0]), "front key")
                key = int(e[0], 16)
                check(prev is None or key > prev, "front sorted")
                prev = key
                check(0 <= e[1] <= 10 and 0 <= e[2] <= 131071, "front locator")
        # padding of the last row
        for s in range(11):
            if img["cells"][s] % 2 == 1 and img["banks"][s]:
                word = bits_of(img["banks"][s][-1])
                check(field(word, 128, 128) == 0, "final upper half zero")
        # walk
        if img["root"] is not None:
            self.visit(img["root"][0], img["root"][1], None, None, 0, 0, 0, 0, False)
        for e in img["front16"]:
            key = int(e[0], 16)
            self.visit(e[1], e[2], None, None, 16, 16, key << 48, 0, False)
        for e in img["front64"]:
            key = int(e[0], 16)
            self.visit(e[1], e[2], None, None, 64, 64, key, 0, False)
        # every cell covered
        for s in range(11):
            for c in range(img["cells"][s]):
                check((s, c) in self.owner, "cell %d stage %d uncovered" % (c, s))
        # subtree sizes and types
        for i in range(len(self.nodes) - 1, -1, -1):
            n = self.nodes[i]
            total = n["local_count"] + len(n["inlined"]) + sum(self.nodes[c]["subtree"] for c in n["children"])
            n["subtree"] = total
            if total == 1:
                check(n["type"] == 4 and not n["children"] and n["local_count"] == 0 and len(n["inlined"]) == 1,
                      "subtree of one must be type4")
            elif total == 2:
                check(n["type"] == 5 and not n["children"] and n["local_count"] == 0 and len(n["inlined"]) == 2,
                      "subtree of two must be type5")
            else:
                check(n["type"] in (1, 2, 3), "type")
                cc = len(n["children"])
                if n["type"] == 1:
                    check(cc <= 2, "type1 children")
                elif n["type"] == 2:
                    check(3 <= cc <= 6, "type2 children")
                else:
                    check(7 <= cc <= 64, "type3 children")
        # rebuild the fib
        for n in self.nodes:
            for (length, value, hop) in n["inlined"]:
                self.add_prefix(length, value, hop)
        for n in self.nodes:
            pattern = n["pattern"]
            index = 0
            for pos in range(1, 64):
                if not (pattern >> pos) & 1:
                    continue
                l = pos.bit_length() - 1
                v = pos - (1 << l)
                length = n["G"] + l
                check(self.min_len(n["origin"]) <= length <= self.max_len(n["origin"]), "local length range")
                value = n["region"] | (v << (128 - n["G"] - l)) if l else n["region"]
                hop = img["nexthops"][n["ni_base"] + index]
                index += 1
                check(hop != HOP_NULL, "ni hop null encoding")
                self.add_prefix(length, value, hop)
            check(index == n["local_count"], "ni count")
        check(len(self.prefixes) <= 8192, "prefix count")
        # front completeness
        used16 = {p[1] >> 112 for (l, p) in self.prefixes.items() if 17 <= l <= 64}
        used64 = {p[1] >> 64 for (l, p) in self.prefixes.items() if l >= 65}
        used0 = [1 for (l, p) in self.prefixes.items() if l <= 16]
        f16 = {int(e[0], 16) for e in img["front16"]}
        f64 = {int(e[0], 16) for e in img["front64"]}
        check(used16 == f16, "front16 complete")
        check(used64 == f64, "front64 complete")
        check(bool(used0) == (img["root"] is not None), "root presence")
        # bitmaps
        used_patterns = set()
        for n in self.nodes:
            if n["bitmap_id"] is not None:
                used_patterns.add(n["bitmap_id"])
        check(used_patterns == set(range(len(img["bitmaps"]))), "all patterns used")
        for i, p in enumerate(img["bitmaps"]):
            check(p & 1 == 0, "bitmap bit0 unused")
            check(n["pattern"] == img["bitmaps"][n["bitmap_id"]] for n in self.nodes if n["bitmap_id"] is not None)
        # nexthop vector coverage
        ranges = sorted((n["ni_base"], n["local_count"]) for n in self.nodes if n["local_count"])
        covered = 0
        for base, count in ranges:
            check(base == covered, "ni coverage")
            covered += count
        check(covered == len(img["nexthops"]), "ni vector length")
        # node bitmaps
        for i, n in enumerate(self.nodes):
            expect = self.expected_bmp(n)
            check(n["bmp"] == expect, "node bmp %d != %d" % (n["bmp"], expect))
        return self.prefixes

    def min_len(self, origin):
        return 0 if origin == 0 else origin + 1

    def max_len(self, origin):
        return {0: 16, 16: 64, 64: 128}[origin]

    def add_prefix(self, length, value, hop):
        value = mask(value, length)
        key = (length, value)
        check(key not in self.prefixes, "duplicate prefix")
        self.prefixes[key] = hop

    def expected_bmp(self, n):
        best = None
        best_len = -1
        for (length, value), hop in self.prefixes.items():
            if length > n["G"]:
                continue
            if (n["region"] >> (128 - length)) == (value >> (128 - length)):
                if length > best_len:
                    best = hop
                    best_len = length
        return HOP_NULL if best is None else best

    def visit(self, stage, cell, parent, parent_stage, origin, G, region, bulk):
        img = self.img
        check(0 <= stage <= 10, "stage range")
        check(cell < img["cells"][stage], "cell range")
        check((stage, cell) not in self.owner, "duplicate node")
        if parent_stage is not None:
            check(stage < parent_stage, "child stage not lower")
        word = bits_of(img["banks"][stage][cell // 2])
        half = cell % 2
        if bulk:
            check(half == 0, "bulk cell parity")
        rec = 0 if bulk else half * 128
        ntype = field(word, rec, 3)
        check(1 <= ntype <= 5, "node type")
        half_size = ntype in (1, 4)
        slot = 2 if bulk else (1 if half_size else 2)
        if not half_size:
            check(half == 0, "two cell slot parity")
        if bulk and half_size:
            check(field(word, 128, 128) == 0, "bulk upper half zero")
        check(cell + slot <= img["cells"][stage], "slot range")
        check(G <= self.max_len(origin), "depth range")
        node = {"type": ntype, "origin": origin, "G": G, "region": region, "stage": stage,
                "cell": cell, "parent": parent, "children": [], "inlined": [],
                "pattern": 0, "ni_base": 0, "local_count": 0, "bmp": field(word, rec + 3, 22),
                "bitmap_id": None, "bulk_stage": None}
        self.nodes.append(node)
        me = len(self.nodes) - 1
        for i in range(slot):
            self.owner[(stage, cell + i)] = me
        if ntype in (1, 2, 3):
            bitmap_id = field(word, rec + 25, 16)
            check(bitmap_id < len(img["bitmaps"]), "bitmap id range")
            pattern = img["bitmaps"][bitmap_id]
            check(pattern & 1 == 0, "bitmap bit0")
            ni_base = field(word, rec + 41, 22)
            count = bin(pattern).count("1")
            check(ni_base + count <= len(img["nexthops"]), "ni range")
            if count == 0:
                check(ni_base == 0, "empty ni base")
            node["pattern"] = pattern
            node["ni_base"] = ni_base
            node["local_count"] = count
            node["bitmap_id"] = bitmap_id
        children = []
        if ntype in (1, 2):
            slots = 2 if ntype == 1 else 6
            check(field(word, rec + (127 if ntype == 1 else 255), 1) == 0, "reserved")
            seen_absent = False
            last = -1
            for k in range(slots):
                v = field(word, rec + 63 + 32 * k, 32)
                if v == ABSENT:
                    seen_absent = True
                    continue
                check(not seen_absent, "absent ordering")
                key = v & 0x3F
                cstage = (v >> 6) & 0xF
                ccell = v >> 10
                check(cstage <= 10, "child stage")
                check(key > last, "child keys sorted")
                last = key
                children.append((cstage, ccell, key, False))
        elif ntype == 3:
            check(field(word, rec + 249, 7) == 0, "reserved")
            bulk_bitmap = field(word, rec + 63, 64)
            bulk_base = field(word, rec + 127, 22)
            bulk_stage = field(word, rec + 149, 4)
            check(bulk_stage <= 10, "bulk stage")
            check(bulk_base % 2 == 0, "bulk base parity")
            node["bulk_stage"] = bulk_stage
            seen_absent = False
            last = -1
            direct = []
            for k in range(3):
                v = field(word, rec + 153 + 32 * k, 32)
                if v == ABSENT:
                    seen_absent = True
                    continue
                check(not seen_absent, "absent ordering")
                key = v & 0x3F
                cstage = (v >> 6) & 0xF
                ccell = v >> 10
                check(cstage <= 10, "child stage")
                check(key > last, "child keys sorted")
                last = key
                check(not (bulk_bitmap >> key) & 1, "direct/bulk overlap")
                direct.append((cstage, ccell, key, False))
            children.extend(direct)
            bulk_count = bin(bulk_bitmap).count("1")
            check(bulk_count >= 4, "bulk count")
            base = bulk_base
            for key in range(64):
                if not (bulk_bitmap >> key) & 1:
                    continue
                children.append((bulk_stage, base, key, True))
                base += 2
        elif ntype == 4:
            check(field(word, rec + 119, 9) == 0, "reserved")
            inlined = [(rec + 25,)]
        else:
            check(field(word, rec + 213, 43) == 0, "reserved")
            inlined = [(rec + 25,), (rec + 119,)]
        for base in inlined:
            fragment = field(word, base[0], 64)
            length = field(word, base[0] + 64, 8)
            hop = field(word, base[0] + 72, 22)
            check(hop != HOP_NULL, "inline hop null")
            rel = length - origin
            check(0 <= rel <= 64, "inline rel")
            check(self.min_len(origin) <= length <= self.max_len(origin), "inline length range")
            if rel < 64:
                check(fragment & ((1 << (64 - rel)) - 1) == 0, "fragment host bits")
            bits = 0 if rel == 0 else fragment >> (64 - rel)
            value = (region & ((1 << 128) - (1 << (128 - (origin + rel)))) if origin + rel < 128 else region)
            value = value | (bits << (128 - origin - rel))
            check(length >= G, "inline length vs depth")
            check((value >> (128 - G)) == (region >> (128 - G)), "inline in region")
            node["inlined"].append((length, value, hop))
        if ntype == 5:
            check(node["inlined"][0][:2] != node["inlined"][1][:2], "type5 distinct")
        for cstage, ccell, key, isbulk in children:
            child_region = region | (key << (128 - G - 6))
            idx = self.visit(cstage, ccell, me, stage, origin, G + 6, child_region, isbulk)
            self.nodes[me]["children"].append(idx)
        return me
